# Everett Cento
> AI consultant based in Portland, Oregon, building custom AI systems and workflow automations for small businesses and solopreneurs, one-on-one.

## What he does
- Custom AI systems and workflow automation fit to how your business already runs
- One-on-one, no agency handoffs, no templated build
- Based in Portland, Oregon; serves the Pacific Northwest and remote clients across the US
- Building custom AI for small businesses since 2025

## Proof
- Automated content pipeline: raw podcast episode to five publish-ready assets in under 10 minutes instead of 4+ hours
- Automated lead qualification platform: 24/7 prospect diagnostic engine requiring zero manual consultant hours
- Custom operations dashboard: saved leadership ~5 hours of manual status chasing every week
- Eden Method customer response system: handling customer comments across 400,000+ followers for nearly two years

## Flagship Offerings
- The Business Brain: $1,000 flat fee, 1-week build. A private knowledge vault and operational AI workspace trained on your business tone, FAQs, and workflows.
- Fractional AI Lead: Monthly retainer. Dedicated monthly automation sprints, custom tool development, and ongoing system maintenance.
- Custom Automations & Tools: Fixed-scope workflow automations, custom web tools, and data pipelines quoted per project.
- Team Workshops: Custom live AI building workshops for teams, studios, and communities.
